rw-a: Somewhere in your history there's probably a time you handled something hard and came out of it respecting yourself a little. Go find it. What did you do, and what was helping you then? If one piece of that is still within reach, use it. The example can be small (it doesn't have to top this one). It's also no proof you should manage the same way today, when you might be more worn out or missing whatever helped you then. (No example? Try another way in.)
hc1-k: With a little warmth to work with, rest one hand at the center of your chest (the heart chakra) and feel for love, and the other on the solar plexus, just below, and feel for your little one. The solar plexus is the most vulnerable part of the torso, as anyone who's been hit there can tell you. So it makes sense to look for your little one there.
hc2-n: Picture the love traveling from your heart down to your little one. If some comes back up, let it, and send it on down again, so it goes around like a loop. That part's a gift from them, and they don't owe it to you, so if nothing comes back, just keep sending yours. No warmth today? Then rest your hands there and notice what you find, no faking required.
ks1-s: Maybe you're reading this with a plan, or the means, close by. Then before anything else, get another human being involved, and put some distance between you and the means. A crisis line or an emergency number counts, and the person on the other end can be a total stranger. Do the same if you can't stop yourself, or you're badly disoriented or intoxicated. Can't tell if that's you? Treat it like it is. This isn't me answering whether life is worth living. It just keeps the question open long enough to look at.
ks7-f: So, if everything's already on the table, what's the change you still can't bring yourself to make? Leaving? Quitting? Moving? Telling your family who you really are? Those aren't free, and you can't always take them back, but they're smaller than dying, and they can wait until you're calmer and have some help. Look at that life you've been afraid to change while you still have a human body, and people around to help redirect the path.
